description: The chart illustrates two metrics for four prompting/reasoning methods—Accuracy (%) and Token Count—shown as two side-by-side groups of colored bars. The category axis is horizontal with no explicit tick labels; instead, the left group is labeled by the top title “Accuracy (%)” and the right group by “Token Count,” and within each group the bars appear in the same left-to-right order as the legend: CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT. The left vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale from 70 to 100 with evenly spaced tick marks at 5-point intervals, while the right vertical axis is labeled “Token Count” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 800 with tick marks every 100. In the Accuracy group, the red CoT bar is labeled 91.19, the orange CoD bar is labeled 80.89, the light-blue CCoT bar is labeled 88.50, and the green CoUT bar is labeled 88.40. In the Token Count group, the red CoT bar is labeled 676.85, the orange CoD bar is labeled 534.24, the light-blue CCoT bar is labeled 445.91, and the green CoUT bar is labeled 354.46. The bars are not stacked and are visually grouped by metric with a gap between the two groups; each bar has a numeric value annotation above it, and there is no indication that bars are sorted beyond the consistent legend-based ordering.
